A Thoughtful Gift for Mental Well-Being

Mental health matters, and sometimes, the best way to show you care is by offering support, healing, and a safe space to talk. With eMbrace’s "Gift a Therapy" program, you can gift a personalized therapy session to a loved one, friend, or colleague.

How It Works

Choose a Session

- Select a standalone therapy session or earn free sessions through referrals.

Personalized Gifting

- Add a heartfelt message to make it special.

Seamless Booking

- The recipient schedules their session at their convenience.

Show someone they’re not alone.
Gifting Made Easy
Standalone Gift Session

One-time gift for a friend, colleague, or loved one.

Empower yourself & others with mental well-being

Start Gifting

When my friend gifted me a therapy session, I didn’t realize how much I needed it. It changed my perspective and gave me the support I was looking for

I had always wanted to try therapy, but I never took the first step. My sister’s gift helped me begin my journey to self-care.

“The care team made us feel supported every step of the way.”

A small act of kindness can make a world of difference.

Gift Now
Why Choose eMbrace?
Confidential & Expert-Led Therapy - Sessions with licensed professionals
Flexible & Hassle-Free Booking - Easy scheduling for recipients
A Gift That Lasts - Supporting mental well-being creates lasting impact
Gift support, healing, and mental wellness today!
